title: Cobblemon PokeNovaGuard
description: Server-side visitor protection and role management mod with /pgn commands, blocked interactions, staff alerts, configurable role prefixes, and an in-game clickable Discord message.
body:
Cobblemon: PokeNovaGuard

🛡️ Cobblemon: PokeNovaGuard is a server-side protection and role management mod for Minecraft servers.

🚀 Version 2.0.0 is a major update that expands the mod with new protection systems, better server control, and more tools for both staff and players.

🎯 It is designed for servers that want to keep new players in a restricted visitor state, protect important server areas, and allow players to secure their own homes safely.

📌 What this update adds

👤 When a player has no role yet, the mod automatically assigns the visitor role.

🚫 Visitors are prevented from:
🔹 breaking blocks
🔹 placing blocks
🔹 opening protected containers
🔹 opening ender chests
🔹 using protected crafting and utility blocks
🔹 modifying item frames

🎮 Visitors can still stay online and play normally while waiting for a staff-assigned role.

✅ The visitor role is mainly focused on preventing building, container access, and protected block interactions.
🛡️ This allows new players to remain on the server safely without being able to modify protected areas before receiving their proper role.

📢 The mod also sends staff alerts when a visitor repeatedly tries to perform blocked actions.

🏷️ Included roles

🔹 visiteur
🔹 dresseur
🔹 champion
🔹 la_famille
🔹 co_fondateur
🔹 fondateur

📂 These roles are used through the mod command system and for team-based role labels and prefixes.

🆕 New in Version 2.0.0

🧱 Protected Staff Zones
Staff can now create protected server areas such as:
🔹 spawn
🔹 shops
🔹 arenas
🔹 important server builds

⚙️ Zone rules can control:
🔹 block breaking
🔹 block placing
🔹 containers
🔹 ender chests
🔹 utility blocks
🔹 item frames

👑 The fondateur role can bypass protected staff zones.
👥 Specific players can also be authorized inside a staff zone.

🏠 Player Claims
Players can now create protected claims for their houses or personal areas.

✅ Claims support:
🔹 owner protection
🔹 member management
🔹 claim listing and info
🔹 overlap protection with staff zones
🔹 overlap protection with other player claims

🛡️ This allows players to protect their homes without interfering with protected server areas.

🧰 Restricted Items
Version 2.0.0 also adds a restricted item system.

🚫 This can be used to block dangerous or unwanted items for all roles except the configured bypass role.

🔒 It is designed to help limit griefing tools, explosive items, and restricted modded tools such as Just Hammers.

💬 Visitor messages

📣 When a player is a visitor, the mod can display:
🔹 a blocked actionbar message
🔹 a visitor title
🔹 a visitor subtitle
🔹 a clickable in-game Discord message

🔗 This Discord message is shown inside Minecraft chat.
❌ It does not send anything to Discord.

⌨️ Commands

🧩 Role commands
/pgn role set <player> <role>
/pgn role get
/pgn role get <player>

🛡️ Staff zone commands
/pgn wand
/pgn zone create <name>
/pgn zone remove <name>
/pgn zone list
/pgn zone info <name>
/pgn zone flag <name> <flag> <true|false>
/pgn zone whitelist add <zone> <item_id>
/pgn zone whitelist remove <zone> <item_id>
/pgn zone player add <zone> <player>
/pgn zone player remove <zone> <player>

🏠 Claim commands
/pgn wand
/pgn claim create <name>
/pgn claim remove <name>
/pgn claim list
/pgn claim info <name>
/pgn claim addmember <name> <player>
/pgn claim removemember <name> <player>

♻️ Reload the config
/pgn reload

⚙️ Configuration

📁 The mod now stores its files here:
config/cobblemon-pokenovaguard/

📄 Files used by the mod:
🔹 pokenovaguard.properties
🔹 pokenovaguard-zones.json
🔹 pokenovaguard-claims.json

🛠️ You can customize:
🔹 role labels
🔹 role prefixes
🔹 role colors
🔹 blocked messages
🔹 visitor title and subtitle
🔹 Discord link and Discord text
🔹 founder name
🔹 permission levels
🔹 zone behavior
🔹 claim limits
🔹 restricted items
🔹 command aliases
🔹 cooldowns for blocked messages and staff alerts

📦 Technical info

🔹 Minecraft: 1.21.1
🔹 Loader: Fabric
🔹 Environment: Server-side

📝 Notes

🛡️ Version 2.0.0 is a major update focused on visitor protection, protected staff zones, player claims, and better server control.

📈 More updates may come in the future if I see support for the project.
❤️ If the mod receives support and feedback, I would like to continue improving it with new features and updates over time.
